notes.title: Cheap Car Repair - Devlog #9
notes.content:
[h3][b]🚗News Time!🚗 
Ready? Steady. Go! Janusz The Mechanic here again with extraordinary news from the workshop![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]🚘A classic ride 🚘[/b][/p][p]The Big Fiax 690p joins our workshop in all it's glory. This beautiful limousine could get you anywhere, regardless if it is a city tarmac road or a dirt path near a forest. The car is the bigger brother of the Fiax 420p of the polish engineering mind, a real monster on the road. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/f4772340f7437eb6574d30db9c8cdc77ae13aa84.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]⚗️Moonshine⚗️[/b][/p][p]Have you ever wanted to be a local country alchemist? Then the moonshiner is the tool you'll need for that. Some potatoes and some more kitchen ingredients can make a perfect moonshine, which will make working on the cars way more fun.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/547e2bcdf6a0062bff3ae3d66ee8eeeabe38ee46.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🛠️Join us on Discord! There's news about the game, contests, our community and more!🛠️[/b][url="https://discord.gg/PKUrvf736X"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/38df01dcc8c93b6f50be0336f920725fba9e4773.png"][/img][/url] [/p][p][/p][p][b]📖World lore expanded 📖[/b][/p][p]The village expands with new lore and quests. While you explore, you can encounter various interesting things in the world. Here's a little sneak peak to one of them. A car slammed into the wall of a building? I wonder where the driver might be. He might've ran away and be in shock... [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/489cecf17815b1579eb6aae70cb1f6decc2181a9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🍾Stay hydrated 🍾[/b][/p][p]New, classic soft (and not so soft) drinks appear. Here are some of them: Lemonidas - citrusy and refreshing, Bożena - classic polish soda, Ireland - a traditional vodka from abroad.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/a78fc7e30053827f1174f3eb44421917f5529f61.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🎵Leave us a follow on TikTok! There we have a lot of new funny and interesting videos about the game.🎵[/b][/p][p][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@littledoggamesret][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/dc7742026d2422fd7e4cf013b6a45c6b7f138bb9.png"][/img][/url][b]   [/b][/p]

notes.title: Cheap Car Repair - Devlog #8
notes.content:
[h3]🚗It's time again!🚗
Welcome to our next Devlog under the lead of Janusz The Mechanic. I am going to give you a small sneak peak at what's brewing in our workshop![/h3][p][/p][p][b]🐐Goats... on the roof?🐐[/b][/p][p]In the village, it's just a day like any other. Sometimes the stubborn goat doesn't want to get out of the barn and out to the field, so you got to manage and improvise - take the thing, put it on the roof and drive it to the field. Country people make do.[/p][p][u][i]DISCLAIMER: No goat has been injured while making the game. The driver is a professional.[/i][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/2da8140e92612dd3172ce41e95dbb1d3b9aeea48.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]📖World lore📖[/b][/p][p]We're working full throttle on new quests that'll spice up the gameplay with even more wild adventures. They're sure to pull you into the crazy life of our wacky village. Main and side missions will be diverse - from neighborly pranks to thought-provoking village skirmishes among the local community. See for yourself:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/37f5b1d8038eb6b27f543bcd71b12d2be60f4124.jpg"][/img][i]Here's the Village Head Office building - the Sołtys's domain. The hub of the village community’s administration and economy. Sounds important. Surely, he diligently works toward the good of the community - like any politician.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/ca581ef8584102130277e75414bec161549ed27e.jpg"][/img][i]Neighborly relations in the village can be as lively as the weather. Sometimes it's all good. Other times, you need to make it crystal clear to your neighbor that you don't see eye to eye.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/940bafc810e919b8827a8817c20a1b7c281c004d.jpg"][/img][i]"Drink... then drive? Was that how it went?" - probably what the driver of this particular vehicle thought. Such a shame for a fancy machine imported from Germany to end like this.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]🛠️Join us on Discord! We've got tons of game news and updates there! From time to time, you can also take part in contests!🛠️[/b][url="https://discord.gg/PKUrvf736X"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/38df01dcc8c93b6f50be0336f920725fba9e4773.png"][/img][/url] [/p][p][/p][p][b]⛰️Open World Development⛰️[/b][/p][p]Our open world is growing like crazy! We're adding new buildings, planting forests, and putting up plot fences to make exploration even more exciting. While roaming the village, you'll stumble upon plenty of main and side quests. Here are a few screenshots of how our village is coming along:[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/bf2795b31c214a66b356e85735302751abfdb123.jpg"][/img][i]Say what you will, but a police station is a must. The cops keep a sharp eye on everyone in the village to maintain order![/i][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/0559b58981b10a68ea473e08fcb786e357e86d90.jpg"][/img][i]An idyllic spot in the forest with beehives and flowers. The perfect place to unwind after a long day of plowing the fields.[/i][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/76301c8d539ea3abc3e090c429f7045aafd4867e.jpg"][/img][i]Local works of art in the form of murals painted on the buildings reflect the community's sentiments toward its members.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/1849245aa72d2742b587aa3feb16914ea36f33d1.jpg"][/img][i]Towering over our village is the beautiful [b]B[/b]ig [b]B[/b]rown [b]C[/b]hurch, reminding every resident of their sinfulness. It recently got a renovation, but the priest is already nagging for another - parishioners are kindly asked to toss banknotes into the collection plate, as coins jingle too loudly.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]🎵Fancy a laugh? Then check out our TikTok! We let our game-inspired imagination run wild there.🎵[/b][url=https://www.tiktok.com/@littledoggamesret][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/dc7742026d2422fd7e4cf013b6a45c6b7f138bb9.png"][/img][/url][b]   [/b][/p]

notes.title: Cheap Car Repair - Game Title Update!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi! We have a quick announcement for you.[/h3]
[b]The game’s title is getting a slight makeover in the English version.[/b]

[b]Why?[/b] 
We’re aiming for better visibility, so we’re changing the title to something a bit less generic and more in line with the game’s theme.

[b]You might be wondering what we came up with? [/b]
Well, it took us not a day, not two… Actually, we didn’t really think at all. And so we ended up with:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/f50741aa981d367bb8a718386e8fa982e233ed95.png[/img]

[i]We figured a game about sloppy repairs deserved a sloppy title rework to match![/i]

We’re hoping this change will bring us fame, fortune, and the glory we’ve always dreamed of. Cheers!
~ Little Dog Games

notes.title: Car Repair - Devlog #7
notes.content:
[h3]Time to get to work, tinkerers! Janusz the Mechanic is back with another Devlog. This time, we’re showing off what cool stuff we’ve added and fixed in the game![/h3]

[b]General Store[/b]
Introducing the shiny new general store, "Kufelek"! You can grab beers, wines, and all sorts of goodies here. We plopped it down not far from the player’s house, so you can easily pedal your bike there and back… or maybe just push it if a gusty wind starts swaying you side to side. You know how it goes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/2cccc717e9c4e6db4f6272dde3680dbc9328001f.jpg[/img]

[b]Cheap Substitutes… So the Customer Comes Back Soon![/b]
What do a V-belt and a pair of women’s pantyhose have in common? Not much, but you can slap both onto some pulleys! Using pantyhose has its perks: they’re cheaper than a proper belt, and you can bet the customer will be back soon to spend more cash.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/355446084031c3acd065dbf28818c08536265819.jpg[/img]

[b]Mushrooms![/b]
In our last devlog, we talked about adding potatoes you can harvest. Today, it’s all about mushrooms - you can find them scattered around, and with a basket in hand, collect them to make some extra coin on the side.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/87ae7cb3a96043557fe6a1313ae5032617f38676.gif[/img]

[b]Join our Discord! You can dive deeper into the game and follow its development. We host contests, share updates, and answer your questions![/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/PKUrvf736X][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/f8bf8778a2e3e0c5354cd4017442f5425133a862.png[/img][/url]

[b]New Cars[/b]
In the last devlog, we dropped the legendary Knursus C355 into the game. This time, it’s the iconic Rysa and Żul! The Żul comes in two flavors: as a single unit or the pickup variant!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/c72bd4c12b51153619f1bfcdee76ca0e4ece727a.jpg[/img]

[b]Car Decorations[/b]
Now you can deck out every car - who wouldn’t want to stick a pair of antlers on the hood of their Rysa?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/0e1c7476f183282c8c330e7a0ec4f748603a1d62.jpg[/img]

[b]Plowing Fields with Style[/b]
A plow is a must-have in every 1997 Polish village household. You can hook it up to your trusty beast on wheels - the Fiax 126p. Now head out to the fields and plow to your heart’s content!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/895bacf119cf11ba2a16f6a972d148d7143672a7.gif[/img]

[b]Check out our TikTok, where we sometimes let our creativity run wild! Our videos aren’t just for chuckles - you can also learn something new about the game. Give us a follow, and we’ll keep the good stuff coming![/b]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@littledoggamesret][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/5a9dcf7dd6ee71e42a78e68eadb9597b3ba296f0.png[/img][/url]


[b]Check them out![/b]
Car Dealer Simulator from Garage Monkeys gets released on [b]29.05.2025[/b]!
See the first gameplay videos on YouTube and Twitch!😎
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880?utm_source=carrepair

notes.title: Car Repair - Devlog #6
notes.content:
[h3]Fellow Car Repairers! Janusz The Mechanic invites you for the next Devlog, where we’ll show you what’s currently cookin’ behind the scenes and how development’s coming along![/h3]

[b]You are breaking records![/b]
The demo dropped on March 20th and you absolutely smashed our expectations! Car Repair has been getting tons of attention, your feedback has been amazing, and it's clear you’re just as hyped for the full release as we are (seriously, same here :D). Over the past three weeks, so many people have played — and if you’re reading this but still haven’t checked it out, here’s your chance: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3501610/Car_Repair_Demo/. 
Here are some stats from the past 3 weeks:
- Over [b]115,000 people[/b] launched the game!
- [b]25,000 new wishlists[/b] on Steam!
- You sent us [b]14,000 feedback surveys[/b]!
- Peak concurrent players hit almost [b]1,200 at once[/b]!
- [b]3,500 new members[/b] joined our Discord - now we’re [b]over 10,000 strong[/b]!
- The demo has over [b]450 reviews[/b] on Steam and we hit that sweet [b]"Very Positive"[/b] rating!

[b]The mighty, unstoppable… KNURSUS![/b]
During development, we added the iconic Knursus - a must-have machine on every Polish farm in 1997. Made in Poland with Polish brainpower and muscle, this beast can pull a few potato-loaded trailers without breaking a sweat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/04e4045efae8b60d9adc7b8ed00767c6cd98ed91.png[/img]

[b]Interactive… POTATO FIELDS![/b]
Hunger always strikes at the worst times and there’s never anything to munch on. But don’t worry, nature’s got your back. Believe it or not, potatoes just show up underground like this [b]FOR FREE[/b] - check it out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/028fd9bf7f8029ed57385d996bd1f9fab70eb694.gif[/img]

[b]Sometimes you’ve gotta improvise...[/b]
Steering wheel? Valve? Meh. The customer won’t even notice if I swap it out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/79a7f72035b69da01f6e57207b0fde9175e91ada.gif[/img]

[b]By the way, if You want to know more about the game and see some insights on the developemnt - join our Discord, where we organize contests, share news, and answer your questions.[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/PKUrvf736X][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/f8bf8778a2e3e0c5354cd4017442f5425133a862.png[/img]
[/url]

[b]New tools[/b]
We’ve added a bunch of new tools — plus a few extra functions and parts to the ones already in the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/cedf039e08dd3788d72072cd495f05bc89fe03a2.jpg[/img]

[b]Some folks just live suspiciously better than the rest...[/b]
Of course, we’re talking about Christopher Kingman. The man’s estate has grown so much we’re running out of room in the village! Hidden behind a forest and cast-iron fencing, his villainous villa stands alone. Guarded by two stone lions... we’re still wondering where he got the money for all this!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/cccebf29bd75cfdf31b97194862651170639f547.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/0f66c31cfd3bd6a417ea935737312aed1f105b7e.jpg[/img]

[b]Good ol’ folding bike[/b]
The bike’s up and running - it’ll get you past any obstacle… albeit a bit slower than four wheels and an engine. But hey, happy folks don’t count the time! Plus, the basket can carry all sorts of tools or parts. Perfect for a quick trip to the store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/b3974c2fa50dbd6ff9a6dff5707d5c4fdd333bae.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/144db165063771f43e87ebf0bf024559923a606e.jpg[/img]

[b]The Fiax driving system is coming along![/b]
Well… with a few hiccups. Seems like the steering wheel’s got a mind of its own.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/14e8fd3519a2728cba91ab94821ddea5e2a6bb42.gif[/img]

[b]Do you want to have a laugh? Then check out our TikTok where we let our creativity with the game run wild. You can also learn something new about the game from the TikToks, so give us a follow![/b]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@littledoggamesret]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/5a9dcf7dd6ee71e42a78e68eadb9597b3ba296f0.png[/img][/url]

Have you heard that the release of [b]Car Dealer Simulator[/b] from our friends at [b]Garage Monkeys[/b] is just around the corner? Be sure to check it out 😎
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: Free Demo available now!
notes.content:
[h3]It’s happening! – [b]The Demo is now live![/b][/h3] 
You can download it for free right now and step into the shoes of a shady mechanic.

[b]What’s in the demo? This is just a taste of the full game, featuring:[/b]
[list]
[*] A story introduction
[*] 3 car repair jobs
[*] Core repair mechanics with a tutorial
[*] And plenty of hidden easter eggs to discover!
[/list]
Dive into the realities of 1990s Poland and run your own auto repair shop, making decisions that will put your morality and creativity to the test. From mixing gasoline with water and painting over rust to using the cheapest replacement parts – there are plenty of ways to cut costs, but is it always worth the risk? The answer, as always, is: "it depends."
One thing’s for sure – you should download the free demo now and see for yourself!

[h3]Play Demo right now![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3501610?utm_source=steamwidget&utm_campaign=demoavailable&utm_content=ENG

Once you’ve played the demo, we warmly invite you to join our Discord and share your thoughts! You can suggest new mechanics or vehicles you'd like to see in the game and stay up to date with the latest development news.
Make sure to join so you don’t miss a thing!
[url=https://discord.gg/PKUrvf736X][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/f8bf8778a2e3e0c5354cd4017442f5425133a862.png[/img][/url]

[b]When is the full release?[/b]
The release of Car Repair on Steam is planned for September 2025. Initially, the game was set to launch earlier, but due to overwhelming interest and its recognized potential, new mechanics are still being added, and the overall experience is being refined even further.

The game will first be released in Early Access, followed by ongoing development and regular updates. More details on the exact release date and pre-orders will be announced in the coming months.

Make sure to add the game to your wishlist and follow it so you don’t miss the launch!
Now grab your spray cans and get to work – the first customer is waiting to have their rusty sills covered up!


PS. Our friends at Garage Monkeys have released a [b]free demo of Car Dealer Simulator![/b] We encourage you to check it out:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413480/Car_Dealer_Simulator_Demo/

[h3]Car Repair - Add the full version of the game to your wishlist!:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2904040/Auto_Fuszerka/

notes.title: Car Repair - Devlog #5
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there! Janusz The Mechanic is back with a handful of new updates and behind-the-scenes insights from the game development! - Devlog #5[/h3]

The sound of tools in the garage is a true treat for the ears, but we decided to take it a step further to make your work even more enjoyable. Now you can turn on the radio in the workshop, playing great hits from the 90s, or listen to your own playlist! When the radio is on, the wrench starts moving on its own, rust falls off on its own as well, and a positive vibe fills the workshop!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/cdd790947642a14ee820adc6345f894ff14ac460.jpg[/img]

We’ve worked on improving performance and fixing several bugs you reported during testing. One of the most frequently reported issues was the black screen at the game start on some devices – it’s been fixed now.

After building your dream car, it’s time to take it on the road! Now you can hop behind the wheel and embark on an unforgettable journey full of adventures and new missions. Everyone is surely waiting to see how this speed demon performs on the highway!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/90d5ca0ef1a4216aa92e31b19322823ca2d68de6.gif[/img]

Every mechanic has to choose a name for their workshop and an appropriate advertisement. Now you can get creative and showcase your ideas on a sign, making your workshop even more unique!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/50d3aacc4a98c17a139c54e89ee122bd6d42d756.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/46e589bc4367ebdb97f162864573c7e893aec9fe.gif[/img]

[b]By the way, feel free to join our Discord, where we organize contests, share news, and answer your questions.[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/PKUrvf736X][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/f8bf8778a2e3e0c5354cd4017442f5425133a862.png[/img]][/url]

We’re working on an open world! Soon you’ll leave the backyard with your garage and go off in search of adventures and new missions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/2ed9d42da365dfd306e156d948ac62ab962fb60f.png[/img]

In this devlog, we also present WóDe 70 – the universal spray for rust removal, loosening, and releasing!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/d51fa5140e32ddddacb58ad9dcb94b007fb96be5.gif[/img]

Bikes and car parts, like wheels and rims, have been better optimized, for example we reduced the triangle count 6 times from 300k to 50k by some simple mesh optimization!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/353edbd6591685bfedae65ecc3ee3dde81316420.gif[/img]

[b]Stay updated and visit us on TikTok![/b]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@littledoggamesret][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/5a9dcf7dd6ee71e42a78e68eadb9597b3ba296f0.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Car Repair - Devlog #4
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome to Devlog 4! - Today, another batch of updates from behind the scenes.[/h3]

Work is in full swing on the next car. We're currently configuring the parts under the hood to make tinkering with the engine a pure pleasure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/9598b99fa0da54072460d991f8dcab7d288a0ced.gif[/img]

Our programmer is working tirelessly on implementing the quest system - yes, those will be in the game! After all, who wouldn’t want to, for example, steal electricity from a neighbor? But more on that soon! 😉
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/55de7eba574e4c1b1b26589282999548ace6af74.gif[/img]

As for the story, we're also working on the game’s intro, which you’ll likely be able to see on our TikTok soon, and we warmly invite you to check it out!
Here’s a short sneak peek in gifs!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/9e76b4c0691f3382958ac81588c65dd392e3d938.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/0ba48eb5e4bdeead8d606661547a3bb010c57c5d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/0c67c7a53e84fb8869195a942fa2b6320b32f239.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/c72a0adeebdf4e014d2144a17b781dda524a67c5.gif[/img]

[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@littledoggamesret]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/5a9dcf7dd6ee71e42a78e68eadb9597b3ba296f0.png[/img][/url]

Besides that, we’re continuing work on the interfaces – in the image below, you can see the job window with detailed information about the car currently being "repaired."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/932fd6917d96094d19b7b11fd072e9f937aa753d.png[/img]

This time, we had a brainstorming session on our Discord about the names for fluids in the game, such as oil and coolant. We picked a few suggestions, and here are the final containers – my favorite is the windshield washer fluid "Hawk Tuah."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/8891549277e7f1c2df35f445e62a8418cf2f38d7.png[/img]

[b]P.S. We’re planning a little surprise for you in the near future![/b] 
I don't want to give away too much, but maybe some of you are interested in testing the game? We’ll share more details very soon – and to make sure you don’t miss anything, be sure to join our Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/PKUrvf736X]

notes.title: Car Repair - Devlog #3
notes.content:
[h3]Hi, this is Janusz the mechanic, and without further ado, welcome to Devlog number 3![/h3]

At the moment, we're continuing work on the interfaces—we briefly introduced them in the previous Devlog. Now, you can see them in action, so below are some GIFs! 😉

[b]Submission of a task:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/d7cfd2da2ab9ba2b5e9c81ca7271f3222deb6bcd.gif[/img]

[b]Catalog:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/21de9a85c5b43fecc568c81ba4422452cf336bb6.gif[/img]

[b]Main menu:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/d2c65b726b8ff7f9cb778419583e8604d2c6f930.gif[/img]

If you spotted something interesting in the GIFs, we warmly encourage you to share it with the community!
[url=https://discord.gg/PKUrvf736X]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/f8bf8778a2e3e0c5354cd4017442f5425133a862.png[/img][/url]

It's worth being on Discord—recently, we even held a contest there, and the winner got to come up with the name for one of the products in the game. So, we’re excited to introduce the newly added wine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/d01ea9e01b74a69643e55597e28c1b5a4ff716dd.png[/img]

Anyway, right now the work is focused more on the technical side of the gameplay rather than the actual gameplay itself. All I've been seeing for a while are lots of numbers, letters, and strange symbols that I don’t understand—but the programmer assures me that everything is working 😉 

So we’re configuring, implementing, and fixing—round and round! We're starting to see the results gradually!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/906b27f502a9617fe2339b1422fc7b4d9d50285f.gif[/img]

Right now, for example, we're focusing on getting our so-called "shoddy work rating system" to function properly—this will assess how poorly you’ve done the job on the car! We can’t wait for you to take a grinder or putty knife into your hands and do some more patching up of the client’s vehicle.

[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@littledoggamesret]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/5a9dcf7dd6ee71e42a78e68eadb9597b3ba296f0.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Car Repair - Devlog #1
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there! We have a small update for you about the progress we're making on the game![/h2]

As you may have seen in some of the videos we've shared or on TikTok (which we warmly invite you to follow), we are slightly modifying the mechanics of assembling and disassembling parts.
We listened to our community in a poll conducted on Discord, and we decided to go more in the direction reminiscent of the game "My Summer Car." 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/734b51167bfdc1b1f432e3505fdd4dee16c8b3fc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/916c31e480833ad6a47e117f7df5cbcddfdccf6e.gif[/img]

The mechanics related to bodywork have also changed a bit! We don't want to reveal too much, but we can't wait to see how you paint your cars. 🖌️ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/a659769ba9ac7ced2753ec3c818fed040d1ad9a6.gif[/img]

However, before painting, don't forget to cover up imperfections. A bit of filler on dents never hurt anyone. 🧱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/06ce07079f1abec28c83606daa30e2dd858177d0.gif[/img]

A grinder is the only right solution for rust! Change My Mind. 🛠️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/2931ba7151ba8d7e3de3c63f791732e49350bac4.gif[/img]

The lift has been added, is functional, and ready to use. Just watch out for rotten sills so it doesn't go inside the car.🚙

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/aad40fbd5125d38f6e76e140a5179005822f12f0.gif[/img]

"Do like you oughta, add acid to oil". Or something like that? I don't know, I was never good at geography. Anyway, you'd better be careful what you pour into the tank because in Car Repair, you'll be able to make various concoctions.  🧪 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/f2b6e7134324079199338437fc749fc8273e6f7a.gif[/img]


We are currently testing the capabilities of the solutions we are creating and moving into the interface design phase!
We warmly invite you to our social media, especially Discord, so you don't miss any updates related to the game!😉

[url=https://discord.gg/PKUrvf736X][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44968638/f8bf8778a2e3e0c5354cd4017442f5425133a862.png[/img][/url]
